title: kbpublic.file_hits strips urls before the leak scan, so an internal root's qualified path or pointer host inside a url passes, and its cached verdicts do not know the registry
goal: kbpublic.file_hits reads an internal root's qualified path inside a url (it strips urls before the scan), and kbpublic.SCAN_FORM and the verdict cache keys change when the registry's private names change, so a cached verdict never passes a private name added later

run:
import os,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); open(os.path.join(d,"_root.md"),"w").write("---
root: team-z
id_prefix: TZ
visibility: internal
---
"); os.environ["KB_ROOTS"]=d; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kbpublic; h=kbpublic.file_hits("notes.md","see https://corp.example.com/team-z/mdm/x.md",{}); sys.exit(0 if h else 1)
